Description: Unique ID of the infrastructure resource (Primary Key). Common key across all tables.
Business_Purpose: Entity key for every join and relationship.

Description: Naming-convention hostname: ENV-APP-TYPE-seq.
Business_Purpose: Human-readable label for dashboards and drill-through.

Description: Server, Virtual Machine, Container Cluster, Application Server, API Gateway, Database, Storage, Load Balancer.
Business_Purpose: Slice utilization and incidents by technology.

Description: Compute, Storage, Database, Network or Application.
Business_Purpose: Determines which metric drives capacity planning (see README).

Description: Production, Staging, Development or Disaster Recovery.
Business_Purpose: Separate production risk from non-prod noise.

Description: ID of the business application the resource supports.
Business application name.
Business_Purpose: Link infrastructure risk to business services.

Description: Owning business department.
Critical / High / Medium / Low. Production & DR inherit the application tier; Staging is one tier lower; Development is Low.
Business_Purpose: Weighting of risk and prioritisation of remediation.

Description: Data center or cloud region/zone name.
AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud or On-Premises.
South India, East India, West India, Southeast Asia, US East, Europe West.
OS / platform of the resource.
Currently provisioned capacity in Capacity_Unit.
Business_Purpose: Denominator for utilization and capacity planning.

Description: vCPU, GB, Gbps or Requests/Second.
Maximum capacity the resource can be scaled to (platform/hardware limit).
Business_Purpose: Headroom for scale-up vs. needing migration.

Description: Active, Standby (DR), Under Maintenance, Decommissioning (snapshot at 2026-09-30).
Unique reading ID (Primary Key).
Foreign key to Infrastructure_Master.
Date of the reading (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30).
Business_Purpose: Time-series axis; relate to a Date table.

Description: Time of the reading. Critical resources: 3 readings/day, High: 2, Medium/Low: 1.
CPU utilization 0-100 during the sample hour.
Memory utilization 0-100.
Used storage in GB (against provisioned storage for Storage/Database; against attached disk for other types).
Storage used as % of capacity.
Inbound traffic in GB during the sample hour.
Outbound traffic in GB during the sample hour.
Link utilization 0-100 (in+out vs link capacity).
Requests/transactions served in the sample hour.
Concurrent active users/sessions served by the resource.
Business_Purpose: Business load; correlates with CPU, requests.

Description: Average response time in milliseconds.
Percentage of failed requests.
Availability over the trailing 24h (90-100). Reduced by incident downtime.
Normalised work units (transactions/jobs/IO operations) per sample hour.
Unique incident ID (Primary Key).
Foreign key to Infrastructure_Master.
Date the incident started.
Business_Purpose: Incident trend and relation to utilization.

Description: Time the incident started.
Performance Degradation, Capacity Exhaustion, Service Unavailable, Network Congestion, Storage Failure, Database Performance, High CPU, High Memory, Application Timeout, Infrastructure Failure.
Critical / High / Medium / Low technical severity.
Business_Purpose: Prioritisation and KPI of critical incidents.

Description: High CPU Utilization, Memory Exhaustion, Storage Capacity, Network Saturation, Traffic Spike, Application Overload, Hardware Failure, Configuration Issue, Dependency Failure, Unexpected Workload.
Utilization % of the implicated resource metric at incident time.
Minutes of service unavailability (0 for degradations without outage).
Estimated users impacted.
Critical / High / Medium / Low business impact.
Time to resolve (MTTR).
Closed, Resolved or Under Review.
Yes if the incident was avoidable through capacity/proactive action.
Unique capacity-planning row ID (Primary Key).
Foreign key to Infrastructure_Master.
Planning snapshot date (every 4 days).
Business_Purpose: Time axis of the forecast history.

Description: Provisioned capacity (Capacity_Unit of the resource).
Capacity currently used (Capacity_Unit).
Current_Capacity - Current_Usage.
7-day average utilization of the resource's primary capacity metric (CPU for Compute/Application, Storage for Storage/Database, Network for Network).
Month-over-month relative growth of utilization from a 60-day trend (negative = shrinking).
Projected utilization % in 30 days (damped linear trend, capped at 100).
Projected utilization % in 60 days.
Projected utilization % in 90 days.
Planned maximum safe utilization (by criticality/category).
Low / Medium / High / Critical derived from utilization, growth, forecast, threshold, incident history and criticality.
Rule-based remediation recommendation.
